Upstream bundle fragment:

onManualUpdateClick:()=>{this.state.debug&&console.log("Manual update triggered")}

Project-local replacement:

onManualUpdateClick:()=>{var e;null===(e=this.state.api)||void 0===e||e.stopEditing(),this.state.debug&&console.log("Manual update triggered"),this.returnGridValue({type:"manualUpdate",api:this.state.api},"manualUpdate")}

Behavioral change:

1. Commit an active AG Grid cell editor with api.stopEditing().
2. Invoke the component's existing returnGridValue() collector pipeline.
3. Label the triggering event as manualUpdate.
4. Let the existing pipeline call Streamlit.setComponentValue().

The manual.2 build leaves this handler byte-for-byte identical to manual.1.
